initial_application: Commit 088f214be3cbdf3f39fcbe68419ff0f19e543edd added the approved Scope & Usage paragraph to source/healthcareservice/healthcareservice-introduction.xml. No prior combined-branch audit commit for FHIR-49290 was present.

reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current HealthcareService narrative already says it is the intersection of Organization, Location, and Service; can be used as actor, e.g. performer/requester/recipient; and means the people who work with or for that HealthcareService in such cases.
